settingsPhotos.title: Mirror photos
settingsPhotos.intro: A salon can only photograph you on its LUX mirror while this is on for that salon. Withdrawing stops future photos; delete existing ones separately.
settingsPhotos.noSalonsDescription: Shops that take mirror photos appear here after you book with them.
settingsPhotos.termsChanged: Photo terms changed — allow again to continue
settingsPhotos.deleteAtSalon: Delete my photos at this salon
settingsPhotos.myPhotosDescription: See the mirror photos shared with you
settingsPhotos.allowedFeedback: Mirror photos allowed at this salon.
settingsPhotos.withdrawnFeedback: Mirror photos withdrawn at this salon.
settingsPhotos.consentUpdateFailed: Could not update mirror photo consent

deleteDialog.title: Delete your photos at {{shop}}?
deleteDialog.body: Every mirror photo of you at this salon is removed from your photos and from the salon's record. This can't be undone. Your consent setting is not changed.

myPhotos.title: My photos
myPhotos.emptyBody: When a salon you've allowed captures your look on the mirror, it shows up here. You choose which salons may take photos under Settings › Mirror photos.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this photo?
deleteDialog.body: It is removed from your photos and from the salon's record of your visit. This can't be undone.
